name: CHAT Rooms
rules: Place one CHAT in every row, every column and every coloured room. No two CHATs may touch, not even at the corners.
technique.1: A CHAT rules out every other cell in its row, its column and its room, and the eight cells around it.
technique.2: This row, column or room has only one cell left that can take its CHAT, so the CHAT goes there.
technique.3: These are the only cells left for one room, and they all sit in one row or column, so that line's CHAT has to be among them and the rest of the line is ruled out. It works the other way round too: a row or column whose open cells all sit in one room rules out the rest of that room.
technique.4: These rooms can only use these rows or columns, and there are as many rooms as lines, so those lines' CHATs all belong to these rooms and nothing else in the lines can take one.
technique.5: A CHAT in this cell would rule out every cell this row, column or room has left, so this cell cannot take one.
demo.1: Place one CHAT in every row, every column and every coloured room. Tap once to cross a cell out, twice for a CHAT.
demo.2: No two CHATs may touch, not even at the corners.
demo.3: Every room holds one CHAT. The top room has two.
demo.4: This room is a single cell, so its CHAT goes there. Every cell it rules out is crossed off for you.
demo.5: One CHAT in every row, column and room, and none touching.
hint.shadow: The CHAT in row {row}, column {column} rules out every other cell in its row, its column and {room}, and every cell touching it, so the ? cells can't hold a CHAT.
hint.lastCell.row: Every other cell in row {line} is ruled out, so row {line}'s CHAT must go in the ? cell.
hint.lastCell.column: Every other cell in column {line} is ruled out, so column {line}'s CHAT must go in the ? cell.
hint.lastCell.room: Every other cell in {room} is ruled out, so that room's CHAT must go in the ? cell.
hint.lastCell.single: The outlined cell is the whole of {room}, so that room's CHAT goes there.
hint.confined.roomInRow: The only cells left for {room} are the outlined ones, and they all sit in row {line}. So row {line}'s CHAT must come from that room, and the ? cells can't hold one.
hint.confined.roomInColumn: The only cells left for {room} are the outlined ones, and they all sit in column {line}. So column {line}'s CHAT must come from that room, and the ? cells can't hold one.
hint.confined.rowInRoom: The only cells left in row {line} are the outlined ones, and they are all in {room}. So that room's CHAT must be in row {line}, and the ? cells can't hold one.
hint.confined.columnInRoom: The only cells left in column {line} are the outlined ones, and they are all in {room}. So that room's CHAT must be in column {line}, and the ? cells can't hold one.
hint.pigeonhole.roomsInRows: The only cells left for these {count} rooms are the outlined ones, and they all sit in rows {lines}. So those rows' CHATs must all come from these rooms, and the ? cells can't hold one.
hint.pigeonhole.roomsInColumns: The only cells left for these {count} rooms are the outlined ones, and they all sit in columns {lines}. So those columns' CHATs must all come from these rooms, and the ? cells can't hold one.
hint.pigeonhole.rowsInRooms: The only cells left in rows {lines} are the outlined ones, and they are all in just {count} rooms. So those rooms' CHATs must all be in these rows, and the ? cells can't hold one.
hint.pigeonhole.columnsInRooms: The only cells left in columns {lines} are the outlined ones, and they are all in just {count} rooms. So those rooms' CHATs must all be in these columns, and the ? cells can't hold one.
hint.blocked.row: The outlined cells are all row {line} has left. A CHAT in the ? cell would rule out every one of them, by touching it or by sharing its row, column or room, leaving row {line} nowhere for its CHAT. So the ? cell can't hold a CHAT.
hint.blocked.column: The outlined cells are all column {line} has left. A CHAT in the ? cell would rule out every one of them, by touching it or by sharing its row, column or room, leaving column {line} nowhere for its CHAT. So the ? cell can't hold a CHAT.
hint.blocked.room: The outlined cells are all {room} has left. A CHAT in the ? cell would rule out every one of them, by touching it or by sharing its row, column or room, leaving that room nowhere for its CHAT. So the ? cell can't hold a CHAT.
